a. 
__1 Not able or allowed to sacrifice. 
__2 Unfit for a sacrifice; नामेध्यं प्रक्षिपेदग्नौ [[

]], 56; 5. 5, 132. 
__3 Unholy, filthy, foul, dirty, impure; उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् [[

]]; 5. 126, 128; 12. 71. 
__2 An unlucky or inauspicious omen, अमेध्यं द्दष्ट्वा सूर्यमुपतिष्ठेत [[Kāty.]] 
-Comp. 
-कुणपाशिन् a. feeding on carrion. 
-युक्त, -लिप्त a. smeared with ordure, foul, defiled, dirty; [[

Ved. 
__1 Having no wife, a widower. न हि त्वदिन्द्र वस्यो अन्यदस्त्यमेनाँश्चिज्जनिवतश्चकर्थ [[

.]] 
__2 Unknowable. 
-Comp. 
-आत्मन् a. possessing an immeasurable soul, magnanimous, large-minded. m. N. of Viṣṇu.
a. To be measured from all sides; to be reached with an arrow or bolt (?).
